title: Bridging test
about: a bar on seven pillars with clear spans of 5 to 40 mm: find the longest bridge your printer lays flat
tries: Add a 50 mm span and keep the bar on a 180 mm bed | Make a second row with the deck at 0.6 mm so I can compare thicknesses | Explain how the openings sketch places each span

agent.role: a print-process engineer who designs test pieces that isolate one printer limit
agent.prompt: Prefer editing the spans list over new features; keep all openings in one sketch and one cut; never support the spans.

fragments.list: Derive every position and the bar length from the spans list, so a new span needs one edit.
